purpose: What a buyer or a seller can rely on in the LAX registry.

facts: Outside listings show as unproven and not verified by Kognai until verified; search results say so.
An offer is validated and scam screened before any payment; a refused settle removes the row and charges nothing.
Offers whose own site serves a valid AIAX manifest carry an AIAX ready badge and a small ranking boost.
Every listing accepts the Five Immutable Laws.
No account and no key: the x402 payment is the credential.
Prices here are the amounts of the live 402 offers, network fee included; a test fails the build when they differ.
Every settled payment is answered with its transaction hash (the transaction field and the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header) and booked as a receipt.
Kognai never asks for keys or seed phrases.
